name: MedAvail Holdings, Inc.
summary: MedAvail Holdings, Inc. operated as a technology-driven provider of retail pharmacy services and solutions across the United States and Canada. The company specialized in developing and bringing to market self-service pharmacy systems, mobile applications, and kiosk-based solutions. A primary offering was the MedAvail MedCenter, an advanced pharmacy technology designed to facilitate on-site prescription dispensing. This system allowed for direct medication access in various settings, including medical clinics, retail environments, and employer sites, utilizing an audio-visual link that provided real-time supervision and consultation from a licensed pharmacist during dispensing. The corporate headquarters for MedAvail Holdings, Inc. were situated in Phoenix, Arizona. On February 2, 2024, MedAvail Holdings, Inc., along with its affiliated entities, submitted a voluntary petition for Chapter 7 liquidation to the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware.
